topic: Effect of Temperature to Speed of Sound
key_concepts: Sound travels as longitudinal mechanical waves
Sound requires a medium to propagate
Sound travels fastest in solids and slowest in gases
Elasticity and density affect the speed of sound
Sound travels faster in more elastic materials
In the same phase, sound travels slower in denser materials
The speed of sound in dry air at 0°C is about 331 m/s
The speed of sound increases by 0.6 m/s for every 1°C increase in temperature
The speed of sound in air can be computed using v = 331 m/s + (0.6 m/s/°C)T
Reflection is the turning back of a wave when it hits a barrier
Echo and reverberation are examples of reflected sound
